mapper.select: SELECT c.USER_ID, c.SALE_ITEM_ID, c.QUANTITY, c.CREATED_TIME, c.UPDATED_TIME, s.TITLE as PRODUCT_TITLE, s.DESCRIPTION as PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION, u.USER_NAME as SELLER_NAME, s.QTY as AVAILABLE_QTY FROM cart c LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.SALE_ITEM_ID = s.SALE_ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN users u ON s.SELLER_ID = u.ID WHERE c.USER_ID = #{buyerId} ORDER BY c.UPDATED_TIME DESC
SELECT * FROM cart WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND SALE_ITEM_ID = #{saleItemId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (USER_ID, SALE_ITEM_ID, QUANTITY, CREATED_TIME, UPDATED_TIME) VALUES (#{userId}, #{saleItemId}, #{quantity}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND SALE_ITEM_ID = #{saleItemId}
